issues.summary: The postcard's dashed border is a typed colour, so it ignores the theme and dark mode.
The site's own --paper variable is set to a typed colour instead of a role, so the postcard stays light in dark mode.

consequences.note: The postcard keeps its light paper in dark mode, under the dark theme's light text: its message and its To and From lines fail.

issues.summary: The character count is coloured with a style attribute holding a typed grey instead of text-secondary.

consequences.note: The typed grey falls well short of 4.5:1 on the light page.

issues.summary: The form's gap (18px) isn't on the spacing scale.
The top bar's title hard-codes Trebuchet MS instead of the heading font role.
The button's press transition has a typed duration and easing instead of the motion roles.
The generated theme CSS was edited by hand (radius.md changed), so it no longer matches the design guide.
The light text-secondary colour is too faint on the light surfaces (about 2.2:1; it needs 4.5:1).

consequences.note: Every text-secondary text in light mode fails as rendered: the recent list's dates, the postcard's To and From lines, the sent message.

issues.summary: The postcard's small print is primary text faded to 40% opacity, so it's unreadable in light and dark mode.
The tip's dismiss button is 20×20 px; phones need 44×44 px (it passes the 24 px minimum only because nothing sits next to it).
The plane beside the title drifts forever from a script that ignores reduced motion, so it keeps moving for people who ask for less.
The postcard preview sits at the bottom of the page, below the recent list, so it's off screen while you write: you can't see what the fields change.
The send button says "Submit" instead of what it does (Send postcard).
The form sends an empty postcard: nothing checks the fields, so the confirmation says it will be posted to nobody.
The To, Message and From fields have placeholders instead of labels, so the label disappears as soon as someone types and screen readers get no name.
An emoji is used as decoration in the page title instead of the site's own style.
After sending, the page has no way to write another postcard: the form is gone until the page is reloaded.
The recently sent list has no empty state: before the first postcard there is only a heading with nothing under it.
